verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents export and dashboard REST APIs for pulling event data and query results (amplitude-docs-12, amplitude-docs-30), plus cohort export APIs (amplitude-docs-29) and an HTTP ingestion API, all backed by an OpenAPI spec (amplitude-probe-3). This covers documented query/export API access for developers. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the export/query API's completeness and rate limits, and clearer documentation of raw event-level export granularity vs. aggregated chart data.
